# Allowlist for build-scripts/reaper_piicheck.py (run by repo-hygiene.yml).
# Two kinds of line:
#   <path or glob>   the GENERIC detectors skip that file - vendored upstream context or
#                    scrub documentation only. The private deny-list still reads it.
#   <rule>:<value>   accept one value everywhere - public infrastructure or a documented
#                    example. Rules: mail home mac ipv4 ipv6 host basic urlcred.
# Never add a file or a value that carries the maintainer's own personal details: change
# the test or doc to a documentation value instead (RFC 5737 / 3849 / 9637 / 7042).
#
# --- values ---
